notes.title: No Crossing Update - version 1.0.1
notes.content:
v1.0.1:
1.Fixed a bug which may cause game crash when you use item.
2.Fixed a bug which may cause continuous loading when you view leaderboard.
3.You can view leaderboard on main menu now.
4.You can use numeric keyboard to switch item now.

notes.title: No Crossing is released!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. "No Crossing" is released now. This is a score-chase game, hope you guys have fun with it. If you have any advice or bug report, you can start a new discussion or send me an email. I'll fix it ASAP. 
Thanks!

EMAIL: dimi.game.studio@gmail.com
